claims: The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships take place on Thursday, March 19 to Saturday, March 21, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships take place at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse in Cleveland, Ohio.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships feature 330 wrestlers.
ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPNU will broadcast sessions of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships.
All matches of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships, including individual mat feeds, are available on ESPN+.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships use a double-elimination bracket for 330 participants across 10 weight classes.
The weight classes in the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships are 125, 133, 141, 149, 157, 165, 174, 184, 197, 285.

Teams score points in the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships based on individual wrestler advancements, wins by fall, technical falls, major decisions, and placement on the podium from 1st through 8th place.
The 2025 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships were held in Philadelphia.
Oklahoma State holds the record with 34 team titles.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships conclude on Saturday night with the championship finals.
